adjacentAmbiguities.issue: Hakone-Yumoto canonical coordinate is closest to way235600773 (6.37m), a terminal passenger track with a west dead-end. Candidate chooses way235600770 (10.13m), which directly continues west via shared nodes to Tonosawa. Way866484945 provides another parallel passenger departure choice (14.09m alias) joined to same western main-chain node264202856. Source snapshot lacks platform allocation; selected track is representative, not uniquely timetable-proven.
Upbound Tonosawa track24355379 is oneway=yes in chain direction and aliases5.95m. Parallel463680840 is oneway=yes opposing departure direction, so it is not selected.
Upbound Miyanoshita track760662651 is oneway=yes in chain direction with1.73m alias. Parallel760662664 has opposing recorded direction and is not selected.
Upbound Kowakudani track844654846 is oneway=yes in chain direction with4.97m alias. Parallel844654848 has opposing recorded direction and is not selected.

Chokoku-no-Mori nearest station projection lies on the continuous passenger main way866484931 (6.90m alias); identical source edge/projection and forward direction are shared by intervals8 and9. No alternate platform chain is indicated within this135-way snapshot.

Gora terminal has two passenger branches: way235940235 tagged ref1 ends22.42m from canonical station, whereas ref2 way1415683330 continues through1323720688 with closest projection5.56m. Candidate chooses connected ref2 branch on proximity, source main/rail tags and lack of service restrictions, not proof of train-specific platform allocation. Both branches join at node264203596; no invented connection between their terminal endpoints.

trackSharing.note: Both intervals split exactly at the same fraction of the same source segment. The canonical station alias is repeated as a station endpoint and does not connect different platform tracks.
Both intervals split exactly at the same source edge fraction; no platform crossing.

stationRailReview.method: Orthogonal clamped projection on GSI railway segment; independently checked on calibrated original Apple basemap and native z18 view. Canonical physical station and OSM node topology unchanged; only display anchor and interval endpoints change. The retained survey projection is connected by a bounded ~3.2m station display alias.
stationRailReview.acceptance: Original Apple passenger railway line within blue station footprint; must recheck native rebuilt Apps before claiming pass.

6.kind: Apple native original-rail cartographic display override; no underground survey claim

nativeReference.transform: longitude=west+(pixelX-255)/769*(east-west); latitude=north-(pixelY-149)/530*(north-south). AX rounded six-decimal corners; no subpixel accuracy claimed.

join.east: Preserve source47 exactly; short source47→48 tangent guard follows frozen source chord before meeting original Apple rail.
join.west: Preserve source54 exactly; one-metre guard along reverse source54→55 tangent. Two local transition supports approximate the observed sharp western transition rather than rounding it into a generic arc.
join.limit: Frozen west boundary lies about1m from raster black rail. Guard/transition is a bounded display alias; not cartographic point-perfect acceptance.
